releasePlan.notes: Flag evaluation moved post-initLaunchDarkly() (resolves race in original PR where loginOverlay was shown before ldClient was ready). Control path calls showOverlay('GALACTIC DEFENDER', ...) exactly as pre-PR. v1 path shows ENTER CALLSIGN overlay and calls ldClient.identify() per-player. No prerequisites; feature is self-contained.

Blank fields = default auto-release on deploy. prerequisites: [{"flagKey": "flag-xyz", "variation": "on"}]. notBefore: YYYY-MM-DD. reference: ticket/doc URL.
